events.title: Demo update: skills
events.summary: Thanks for all the feedback! A lot of you were getting by on guns alone, so we reworked Jun and Loren's skills. Skills Leo (new): Loren's cat runs from Jun to her. Enemies he passes take 25% more damage. Replaces the Tennis Ball. Pierce: Now shoots through walls and floors. Enemies hit deal 25% less damage. Toss: Loren shoots every enemy she flies over. Taunt: Every enemy turns to face Jun, and Jun takes 25% less damage. Polish Back hits are now crits to reward getting behind enemies. Wall ball

events.title: Demo Update: Claw Machine, a new Siege and a whole lot more
events.summary: Hey everyone! We’ve just pushed another big update to the demo.Claw MachineWe’ve added a new minigame to the solarium! Jun can now rummage around in a planter full of leaves, trying to catch the spore bugs hiding inside while Loren watches. Each kind of bug gives you a different item: herbs, resin, stun grenades or molotovs. Catch a shimmering bug and you’ll get one of everything. events.title: Demo Update: Beetle Battles and a whole lot more
events.summary: Hey everyone! We just pushed a big update to the demo. Beetle battleThere's a new minigame in the solarium. You and Loren put two beetles on a stick and see who can get knocked off first. Beat her to unlock harder rounds and win to get the reward at the end.Loren's Combat Skill: Tennis BallHer Tennis Ball stuns whatever it hits now.CookingEach dish has a chili rating so you know how hard it is before you start. events.title: Demo update: stalks
events.summary: Thank you for all the feedback on the demo. This update is mostly about the pace of the night. Stalks Stalks show you where the next wave will come from, both in the house and on the tactical map. Once a stalk starts growing, you have three rounds to get ready before it bursts. Clear the board and the next wave comes straight in, so the night moves as fast as you do. Stalks pay out resin when they burst, and the faster you clear, the more you earn. events.title: Nightbound Demo Out Now
events.summary: Hey everyone,The Nightbound demo is out on Steam today! It runs on Windows, and it's the first three days and nights of the game.If this is your first look at Nightbound, it’s a turn-based tactics game about two strangers who share one house at the end of the world. They spend the days together and hold the house against the Bloom at night.
